title: Crown Commercial Service and Supplier Framework Agreement (Agreement Ref: RM3765) v2
issuer: Crown Commercial Service (CCS), Cabinet Office, United Kingdom

extraction_settings.download_command: curl -L --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 300 --retry 2 --retry-delay 5 -A "Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" -H "Accept: application/pdf,*/*" -o original.pdf "<URL>"
extraction_settings.raw_ocr_command: pdftotext original.pdf -   # verbatim output, written unmodified to raw_ocr.txt (poppler 26.01.0)
extraction_settings.pages_json_command: pdftotext -f N -l N original.pdf -   # per page N=1..page_count, one-based page_no, assembled in order
extraction_settings.normalization_rules: R1 remove NUL bytes; R2 CRLF and lone CR to LF; R3 U+00A0 and U+2007..U+200B converted to U+0020; R4 ligatures U+FB00-FB06 expanded to component letters; R5 form-feed (U+000C) page markers removed; R6 trailing whitespace stripped per line; R7 runs of 3+ blank lines collapsed to 2; R8 nothing else — no spelling, hyphenation or OCR repair of any kind
extraction_settings.verification_commands: file --mime-type original.pdf; sha256sum original.pdf; head -c 8 (PDF magic check)
